Version 2.0.2 — Major update: Skill now outputs multi-image Xiaohongshu "knowledge" carousels in PNG format for professional users.

- Visual style: uniform warm paper backgrounds, sophisticated brown/orange palette, strict font and density guidelines.
- Designed for high-density, information-rich slides aimed at business/entrepreneurial audiences (not lifestyle/food/travel).
- Detailed slide layouts, content density, and typographic rules provided for precise and consistent output.
